content.text: {"subject":"Fractions: Halves and Quarters","aditiApplicable":true,"aditiHook":"When you share a pizza with a friend, you each get half. But what if 4 friends want equal slices? Then each person gets a quarter. How do you show these parts as numbers?","notes":["A fraction is a way to show a part of a whole thing.","When you divide something into 2 equal parts, each part is called one-half, written as 1/2.","When you divide something into 4 equal parts, each part is called one-quarter, written as 1/4.","The number on top (numerator) tells you how many parts you have. The number on bottom (denominator) tells you how many equal parts the whole is divided into.","Two halves make one whole: 1/2 + 1/2 = 1.","Four quarters make one whole: 1/4 + 1/4 + 1/4 + 1/4 = 1.","Two quarters equal one half: 2/4 = 1/2. They are the same amount, just written differently."]}
